lines: You cook on Wednesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
The shared dish is vegan: that is what Theodule eats.
You left room for separate dishes. Nobody at this table needs one this week: there is a single cook.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Smoky Summer Bean & Potato Bowl
dishes.title: Slow-cooked smoky black beans with roasted sweet potatoes
dishes.method: Assemble the roasted sweet potatoes with a portion of the slow-cooked smoky beans. Top with fresh parsley.
dishes.why: A hearty vegan lunch that uses the smoky theme requested by the house while meeting the 'one loud vegetable' rule with bright sweet potatoes.

dishes.name: Rustic Roast Chicken & Potato
dishes.title: Smoky roasted chicken thighs with sweet potatoes
dishes.method: Plate the roasted chicken thighs alongside the sweet potatoes. Finish with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: A high-protein lunch for Aurele that fits the smoky profile and avoids the shared vegan pot as required.

dishes.name: Slow-Simmered Smoky Bean Stew
dishes.title: Smoky black beans with peppers and sautéed kale
dishes.method: Reheat the beans in a pan with the peppers and kale until piping hot. Drizzle with olive oil before serving.
dishes.why: A warm, smoky vegan dinner for Theodule that features kale as a loud vegetable and provides a comforting evening meal.

dishes.name: Smoky Chicken & Pepper Platter
dishes.title: Roasted smoky chicken with peppers and kale
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, peppers, and kale in the oven on the single tray for 10 minutes. Serve hot with a pinch of chilli.
dishes.why: A large, warm dinner for Aurele that utilises the oven for reheating all components together.

preparations.title: Smoky Roasted Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Rub the chicken with oil, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper. Place on one half of a large baking tray. Roast at 200°C for 35-40 minutes until the skin is crisp and the meat is cooked through.

preparations.title: Slow-Simmered Smoky Black Beans
preparations.method: Sauté the onion in oil until soft. Add the smoked paprika and beans. Pour in the stock and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes until thick and smoky.

preparations.title: Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Peppers
preparations.method: Toss sweet potatoes with oil and roast on the other half of the chicken tray. Add the peppers to the tray for the final 15 minutes of roasting.

preparations.title: Sautéed Kale with Garlic
preparations.method: Heat oil in a large pan. Sauté the garlic for 1 minute, then add the kale and a splash of water. Cook until wilted and tender.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Preheat the oven. Prep the chicken and sweet potatoes, then get them onto the single tray and into the oven. While they roast, start the smoky beans in a pot on the stovetop. Sauté the kale in a pan. Add the peppers to the oven tray for the last 15 minutes. Once everything is cooked, weigh and box into the named containers.
